gaps.s: The lowest level of the sports development pyramid is the ___ level.
The highest level of the pyramid is ___.
A performer paid to take part in sport is a ___.
Hawk-Eye in tennis is an example of ___ in sport.
Time-wasting to protect a lead is an example of ___.
Long-term benefits left after a major event are its ___.
The three Ps of increasing participation are promotion, provision and ___.

short.q: Give two advantages of media coverage to a sport.
short.model: Increased publicity and more income from TV rights; also inspires more people to take part.

short.q: Explain one disadvantage of sponsorship for a sport.
short.model: Sponsors may influence rules or timings, or the sport may suffer if a sponsor has a poor image.

short.q: Describe two benefits of being a host nation.
short.model: New stadia and facilities, and increased tourism and jobs.

short.q: Suggest two ways to increase participation among older people.
short.model: Provide low-cost, accessible sessions and promote activities suited to older people.

short.q: Explain the difference between sportsmanship and gamesmanship.
short.model: Sportsmanship is fair play and respect; gamesmanship bends rules to gain an advantage.
